"''I kinda like it.|JJR-579 and JTN-303, upon sighting a painted TIE fighter|}} '''JTN-303''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[stormtrooper]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] in the [[Imperial Army]]. He was stationed on [[Lothal]] on [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin|Tarkin's]] Imperial [[Star Destroyer]], five years prior to the [[Battle of Yavin]]. ==Biography== JTN-303''[[Battle to the End]]'' was aboard Tarkin's ship, the ''[[Sovereign]]'', as they were transporting Jedi Knight [[Kanan Jarrus]] to [[Mustafar]] for his final interrogation. JTN was stationed at the TIE Fighter Depot. After a [[Rebels TIE fighter|Rebel TIE fighter]] entered the hangar, he thought it looked good, before it set off a stunner, knocking JTN and [[JJR-579|his partner]] out. It was all part of a rescue mission based around Jarrus. When Jarrus and his allies returned to the hangar, JTN had left the area where he had been knocked out. ==Appearances== *''[[Battle to the End]]'' {{1stID|JTN-303}} *{{Rebels|Fire Across the Galaxy}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=JTN-303 |pl=JTN-303 }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire]]
